(734) 752-9667

From: Crawford, Kirkland <kcrawford@freepress.com>
Sent: Thursday, January 23, 2020 3:39 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: RE: Fenech question 
 
No, you don’t have to. I didn’t want to double up. Chris and I were thinking if it was worth having something that, in effect, says the Tigers say they haven’t done that stuff.
We’re still in-between, one way or another.

From: Fenech, Anthony 
Sent: Thursday, January 23, 2020 3:32 PM
To: Crawford, Kirkland <kcrawford@freepress.com>
Subject: Re: Fenech question

I didn't ask anything about Verlander and I really don't want it to be perceived that way, and they're sensitive about my sign-stealing tweet, so I'd lean towards no. I can always touch on it in my main story, if that works

From: Crawford, Kirkland <kcrawford@freepress.com>
Sent: Thursday, January 23, 2020 2:56 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: FW: Fenech question
You writing on this today? Just wanted to see. Looks like there’s some buzz with people and funny comments on it (all good things).
